verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents an official MCP integration that lets any MCP-compatible agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) use it directly as a web search tool, backed by a first-party serpapi-mcp repo. It also offers LLM-optimized markdown output and an llms.txt for agent consumption. Missing for 10: explicit function-calling/tool JSON schemas (the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404), documented agent-framework integrations beyond MCP (e.g. LangChain/LlamaIndex), and independent hands-on corroboration of the MCP tool in use.
